data.description:
## Context / Problem
Discovered while triaging breezy-hogged-mastiff, which owns `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/unclassified.args`. These 20 entries move to `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/locale-tests.args`, which this bug owns.

These test modules read Markdown, YAML and Terraform from the checkout with `read_text()` and no `encoding` (for example `tests/unit/test_rebar_debug_step7_class_review.py:29,34`, `test_code_review_ws2.py:176`, `test_gate_scratch_volume_aa40.py:163-234`). On Windows that decodes UTF-8 files as cp1252. Under `LC_ALL=en_US.ISO8859-1 PYTHONUTF8=0` on macOS all 20 fail even with the `src/rebar` encoding fix of dogtired-blank-fieldmouse applied; ruff `PLW1514` (preview) reports 228 such reads in 108 test files.

Evidence: Windows runs on throwaway branch `tmp/w05-remeasure` with origin/main `717c50f8b33` code plus a selection-only workflow change: run 44665461131 (the 242 `unclassified.args` entries; 48 passed, 194 failed or errored) and run 44681457334 (the 194, xdist, JUnit XML with full tracebacks). Both 2026-11-19 PST.

Modules:
- `tests/unit/test_code_review_recommend_overlays.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/test_code_review_surface_parity.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/test_code_review_ws2.py` (1)
- `tests/unit/test_gate_scratch_volume_aa40.py` (3)
- `tests/unit/test_makefile_worktree.py` (2)
- `tests/unit/test_measurement_provenance_criterion.py` (4)
- `tests/unit/test_rebar_debug_step7_class_review.py` (7)
- `tests/unit/test_s4_prompt_cutover_edge.py` (1)

## Approach
Name `encoding="utf-8"` on the test-side reads, and guard the tests tree (for example enabling `PLW1514` for `tests/`). Remove each line from `locale-tests.args` as it passes.

## Scope
Test or product code for the listed modules, plus `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/locale-tests.args` (remove each fixed line; delete the file and its `@` reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml` once empty).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every line removed from `locale-tests.args` names a test that passed in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `locale-tests.args` is empty and deleted with its reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml`, or each remaining line names a test recorded on this ticket as intentionally unsupported on Windows with the reason.
data.title: Windows sweep: 20 tests read repo text files with the locale codec
